question: historic sites that intersect any building footprint
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.names.primary AS name,
       ST_AsGeoJSON(p.geometry) AS geo
FROM lisbon_places AS p
JOIN lisbon_buildings AS b
  ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry, b.geometry)
WHERE p.taxonomy.primary = 'historic_site'
LIMIT 100;

question: restaurants within 200 meters of a building taller than 80 meters
sql:
WITH tall_buildings AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM lisbon_buildings
  WHERE height > 80
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.names.primary AS name,
       p.basic_category
FROM lisbon_places AS p
JOIN tall_buildings AS b
  ON ST_Distance(
       ST_Transform(p.geometry, 4326, 3857, true),
       ST_Transform(b.geometry, 4326, 3857, true)
     ) <= 200
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
LIMIT 100;

question: buildings that contain a coffee shop
sql:
SELECT b.id,
       b.subtype,
       b.height
FROM lisbon_buildings AS b
JOIN lisbon_places AS p
  ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry)
WHERE p.basic_category = 'restaurant'
  AND p.names.primary ILIKE '%coffee%'
LIMIT 100;

question: places that touch any school building
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.names.primary AS name,
       p.basic_category
FROM lisbon_places AS p
JOIN lisbon_buildings AS b
  ON ST_Touches(p.geometry, b.geometry)
WHERE b.class = 'school'
LIMIT 100;

question: buildings within 500 meters of the Tagus river line
sql:
SELECT b.id,
       b.subtype,
       b.height
FROM lisbon_buildings AS b
WHERE ST_Distance(
        ST_Transform(b.geometry, 4326, 3857, true),
        ST_Transform(
          ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING(-9.2 38.7, -9.1 38.71)', 4326),
          4326, 3857, true
        )
      ) <= 500;

question: open personal or beauty services inside residential buildings
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.names.primary AS name
FROM lisbon_places AS p
JOIN lisbon_buildings AS b
  ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry)
WHERE p.basic_category = 'personal_or_beauty_service'
  AND p.operating_status = 'open'
  AND b.subtype = 'residential'
LIMIT 100;
